title: Number Bonds Mastery Check
objective: Determine whether Number Bond reasoning (missing part, missing whole, bond-to-equation) is secure enough to move into Unit 1.2's benchmark work.

tasks.prompt: Build a bond from a known split.
Solve a missing-part bond and a missing-whole bond, each for a different whole.
Translate a given bond into an equation, and a given equation into a bond.
Explain, without prompting, which position in a bond is always the whole.

mastery.passEvidence: All four tasks correct; the missing-part task specifically must not show the add-instead-of-difference error.
mastery.reteachTrigger: Solves missing-whole bonds but not missing-part bonds (reteach 1.1.4's difference-vs-sum distinction specifically) or cannot translate bond/equation in either direction (reteach 1.1.7).
